'''April 2002 Bloomington tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bloomington, IL on 7 April 2002. It is known from Josh Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3565">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-07-bloomington-il-4-7-02d3565/ bloomington-il-4-7-02], DeckTech (josh "Martic89" schaefer, 7 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-07-bloomington-il-4-7-02d3565/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2002
* '''Site:''' Bloomington, IL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
